continuous_ceiling_derivation.formula: L_max = h*tan(15deg)/(b-a*tan(15deg)); h=source altitude, a=dot(source corner normal, transverse altitude direction), b=dot(source corner normal, original geometric normal)
continuous_ceiling_derivation.meaning: Continuous float64 ceiling only; actual float32 offset and intersection gates must still pass in any separately approved candidate.

limitation: The fixed lift failed before intersection or atlas work; no safe alternative is established.
